an5.111:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato kulupako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an5.111:1.3: Asanthavavissāsī ca hoti anissaravikappī ca vyattūpasevī ca upakaṇṇakajappī ca atiyācanako ca.
an5.111:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kulupako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca. 3.
an5.111:2.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato kulupako bhikkhu kulesu piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.111:2.3: Na asanthavavissāsī ca hoti na anissaravikappī ca na vyattūpasevī ca na upakaṇṇakajappī ca na atiyācanako ca.
